title: SocialArena: Evaluating Social Intelligence in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.39247v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce SocialArena, a benchmark for systematically defining and evaluating the social intelligence of large language models (LLMs). Although LLMs are increasingly deployed in socially interactive applications such as mental health counseling, companionship chatbots, and educational tutoring, existing evaluations remain fragmented focusing on isolated capabilities or single scenarios and evaluation reliability is largely unverified. This work makes three main contributions to address these limitations. (1) We first propose a unified three-tier framework that defines social intelligence along three capability dimensions: role-playing ability, mental state reasoning, and behavioral reasoning. To operationalize this definition, we design a role-playing dialogue paradigm with explicit character thinking for evaluation, enabling simultaneous assessment of these capabilities in a manner that mirrors realistic human interactions. translated_title: SocialArena：评估大语言模型的社交智能
translated_abstract: 我们提出了 SocialArena，这是一个用于系统化定义和评估大语言模型（LLM）社交智能的基准测试。尽管 LLM 越来越多地被部署在心理健康咨询、陪伴聊天机器人和教育辅导等社交互动类应用中，但现有的评估仍然较为碎片化，聚焦于孤立的能力或单一场景，且评估的可靠性在很大程度上未经检验。本工作做出了三项主要贡献以解决这些局限。（1）我们首先提出了一个统一的三层框架，从三个能力维度定义社交智能：角色扮演能力、心理状态推理和行为推理。为将该定义付诸实施，我们设计了一种带有显式角色思考的角色扮演对话评估范式，能够以贴近真实人类互动的方式同时评估这些能力。（2）为了……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: SocialArena 提出了一个统一的三层框架和带有显式角色思考的角色扮演对话评估范式，从角色扮演能力、心理状态推理和行为推理三个维度系统化地定义并评估大语言模型的社交智能。
en_tdlr: SocialArena introduces a unified three-tier framework and a role-playing dialogue paradigm with explicit character thinking to systematically define and evaluate LLMs' social intelligence across role-playing ability, mental state reasoning, and behavioral reasoning.
